summary: Huaxin Gao proposes the inaugural Spark community sync for Nov 30, 2026, outlining a 50‑minute agenda covering recent changes, SPIP status, release updates, and an open floor. The proposal extends Spark’s Real‑Time Mode to eligible distributed batch SQL and DataFrame queries, enabling pipelined shuffle that overlaps producer, transfer, and consumer stages to reduce latency. The discussion covers an updated version of the SPIP proposal, incorporating detailed security guarantees, a dedicated PolicyEnforcement operator, and stricter handling of writes to protected tables. It outlines how the policy row filter acts as a security barrier, only allowing leakproof expressions, and introduces a capability signal to fail closed on older Spark releases.
